instruction: A classic high-top roller skate built entirely from chunky cubic voxels, complete with a blocky toe stop and four stepped wheels. Bright pink boot cubes meet white laces, teal wheels, and a yellow sole, each face flat-shaded in pixel-art color blocks. The staircase edges and cubic proportions give it a crisp retro video-game look.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Voxel Roller Skate in a voxel/pixel style. A classic high-top roller skate built entirely from chunky cubic voxels, complete with a blocky toe stop and four stepped wheels. Bright pink boot cubes meet white laces, teal wheels, and a yellow sole, each face flat-shaded in pixel-art color blocks. The staircase edges and cubic proportions give it a crisp retro video-game look. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
